changeSet.author: OGC-1220
changeSet.comment: History references are polymorphic identifiers. Preserve existing numeric references and allow UUIDs used by QC control lots and other entities. Rollback restores the old type only while all references remain numeric; PostgreSQL rejects rollback after UUID history is recorded, preserving that history rather than deleting or rewriting its identifiers.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ${history.schema}.history ALTER COLUMN reference_id TYPE VARCHAR(255) USING reference_id::VARCHAR(255);

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE ${history.schema}.history ALTER COLUMN reference_id TYPE NUMERIC(22,0) USING reference_id::NUMERIC(22,0);
